scope.subject: OpenAPI 3.1 API v1 contract
scope.mutation_class: contract-only repository change; no runtime or external side effect

risk.rationale: The contract covers public data, reader identity, editorial/publisher actions, optional SIWE and error/security boundaries. Runtime authorization, provider policy and generated-client parity are not verified in this slice.
hard_overrides: Do not approve or merge without human review.
Do not infer runtime authorization from an OpenAPI document.
Do not add credentials, production writes or provider side effects.
unknowns: T009 canonical ContentDocument schema is not available on main.
T010 validator parity and T012 generated-client parity are not yet implemented.
Runtime auth, rate limiting, optimistic locking and audit behavior remain unverified.

controls.note: System card and API inventory are represented by the bounded T011 scope and operation list.
Human merge/checkbox authority is separated from contract drafting.
T011 is gated on T009 main read-back and current-head proof.
Contract examples must minimize fields and avoid secrets or draft content.
No secret values or credential material are permitted in the contract.
Reader/editorial operations must express pre-retrieval authorization requirements.
ContentDocument responses require canonical schema references and evidence-bound examples.
Lint, $ref resolution and representative problem responses are required before review.
The operation allowlist is limited to T011 tasks.md scope.
Publisher transitions and media revoke operations remain human/runtime protected actions.
requestId, audit and stable error fields must be contract-visible without claiming runtime proof.
Human final authority is required for merge and task completion.

authority.dispatch: CONFIRMED by current user direction to start Phase 2 tickets
authority.implementation: BOUNDED after T009 canonical schema is read back from main

required_before_review: representative examples for success and 400/401/403/404/409/422/429 problem responses

next_action: Keep T011 blocked and unchecked until T009 is merged/read back on main; then implement only the OpenAPI contract and run the stated proof.
